    11  # Lifting properties in cochain complexes
    12  
    13  Let `C` be an abelian category. Consider a commutative diagram
    14  in the category `CochainComplex C ℤ`.
    15  ```
    16     t
    17   A ⟶ X
    18  i|   |p
    19   v   v
    20   B ⟶ Y
    21     b
    22  ```
    23  Assume that there exists a degreewise lifting `B.X n ⟶ X.X n` for any `n : ℤ`,
    24  that `Q` is a cokernel of `i`, and `K` is a kernel of `p`. In this situation,
    25  we construct a cocycle in `Cocycle Q K 1` and show that there exists
    26  a lifting `B ⟶ X` if this cocycle is a coboundary.
    27  
    28  -/

    30  @[expose] public section
    31  
    32  namespace CochainComplex
    33  
    34  open CategoryTheory Limits HomComplex
    35  
    36  variable {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C]
    37  
    38  namespace Lifting
    39

    44    {Q : CochainComplex C ℤ} {π : B ⟶ Q} {hπ : i ≫ π = 0}

    46    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} {ι : K ⟶ X} {hι : ι ≫ p = 0}
    47    (hK : IsLimit (KernelFork.ofι _ hι))
    48  
    49  /-- The `0`-cochain from `B` to `X` given by the degreewise liftings. -/
    50  abbrev cochain₀ : Cochain B X 0 := Cochain.ofHoms (fun n ↦ (hsq n).l)
    51  
    52  /-- A `1`-cocycle from `B` to `X` obtained as the boundary of
    53  the `0`-cochain `cochain₀ sq hsq` consisting of the degreewise liftings.
    54  This is refined below as a `1`-cocycle from `Q` to `K` where `Q` is a
    55  cokernel of `i : A ⟶ B` and `K` a kernel of `p : X ⟶ Y` (see `cocycle₁`). -/
    56  def cocycle₁' : Cocycle B X 1 :=
    57    Cocycle.mk (δ 0 1 (cochain₀ sq hsq)) 2 (by simp) (by simp [δ_δ])

    68

    70  set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
    71  @[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    72  lemma comp_coe_cocyle₁'_v_eq_zero (n m : ℤ) (hnm : n + 1 = m := by lia) :

    74    have fac_left (k : ℤ) := (hsq k).fac_left
    75    dsimp at fac_left
